placements.quote: A high statistics search for neutrino oscillations at the 2,800 MW Bugey reactor with the detectors at 15, 40, and 95m

sensitive_volume.quote: three identical 600 l segmented detectors were used

summary.plain: Three identical tanks of liquid scintillator, each split into 98 cells, placed at 15, 40 and 95 metres from a reactor core so their antineutrino spectra could be compared.
summary.technical: Three identical 600 l segmented detectors of 98 prismatic cells viewed by 3-inch PMTs on each side, filled with 6Li-loaded (0.15 %) liquid scintillator; pulse-shape discrimination separates neutron-capture products from positrons.

technology.quote: Each detector consisted of 98 prismatic cells viewed by a 3-inch PM on each side. The cells were filled with 6 Li loaded (0.15%) scintillator.
technology.value: Segmented 6Li-loaded (0.15 %) liquid-scintillator detectors, 98 cells each, with pulse-shape discrimination
